spans.s:
Words which are the names of the points of the compass are compounded, when the compound signifies the intermediate point and the compound so formed is बहुव्रीही।

Terms: समास-बहुव्रीही-संख्या

युट् is the augment of दीङ् of an आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a vowel and having an indicatory क् or ङ्।

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes
